name: Ben Lambert A Student's Guide to Bayesian Statistics
desc: Companion lecture series by Ben Lambert to his book A Student's Guide to Bayesian Statistics, covering probability distributions and likelihoods, Bayes' rule, priors from conjugate to Jeffreys and reference priors, model evaluation with posterior predictive checks, AIC, DIC, WAIC, LOO-CV, and Bayes factors, independent sampling methods including rejection, inverse transform, and importance sampling, MCMC with Random Walk Metropolis, Metropolis-Hastings, Gibbs sampling, and Hamiltonian Monte Carlo, and applied Bayesian modeling in Stan including hierarchical models.
